description: This file defines the CatalogContext class which inherits from Entity Framework's DbContext, encapsulating database sets (DbSet) for various entities related to the catalog, baskets, orders, and order items in the eShopOnWeb project. It also includes configuration setup for entity mappings.

classes.name: CatalogContext
classes.description: A DbContext class representing the database context for the catalog, baskets, and orders in the eShopOnWeb application. It manages access to entities and configuration.
